intelligence.company_overview: Postman is an API platform for building and using APIs. Postman simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so you can create better APIs—faster.
intelligence.target_audience: Engineers, API teams, and enterprises seeking to design, govern, and scale APIs.

intelligence.company_overview: Supabase is a fully managed Postgres platform that provides authentication, real-time data, edge functions, storage, and vector search to build production‑ready applications in minutes. It serves developers, AI builders, startups, and enterprises looking for secure, scalable backend infrastructure.
intelligence.target_audience: Developers, AI builders, and innovation teams building AI‑powered applications and scalable backend infrastructure for startups, agencies, and enterprises.

intelligence.company_overview: Vapi is a unified platform that enables builders to create, deploy, and improve voice agents quickly. It provides orchestration, real‑time monitoring, and enterprise‑grade configurability for scalable voice solutions.
intelligence.target_audience: Enterprises and organizations of all sizes that require scalable, enterprise‑grade voice agent solutions.
